historical_commentary.text: This note simply announces the availability of a revised documentation set shipped with 4D and 4D Server 6.0.2 (also distributed via the Partner CD); it is purely an administrative/distribution notice with no lasting technical content of its own, and both the specific documentation revision and the physical Partner CD distribution channel it describes are long obsolete.
related_updates: 4D documentation is now distributed and updated continuously online rather than via physical CDs tied to specific point releases
4D's Partner CD physical distribution channel described here has been long discontinued in favor of digital distribution
